text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower was desperate to visit a
shrine, so
here we are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for doing this for me, Big
Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for doing this for me, Big
Sister.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, I want to go lots of places with
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Well, I want to go lots of places with
you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want you to get mixed up in
my bad
luck.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want you to get mixed up in
my bad
luck.
choice_data_list: And that's why you're turning to t...
And that's why you're turning to t...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... I thought if we prayed
together, the
gods would definitely
listen.
choice_data_list: And that's why you're turning to t...
And that's why you're turning to t...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... I thought if we prayed
together, the
gods would definitely
listen.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So, will you?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Okay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But, as we're praying...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hyaaa!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Part of the old roof falls off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, it's just like I thought.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But... if I wasn't here, this definitely
wouldn't have
happened...
choice_data_list: Thank goodness that didn't hit me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I should've known. I'm just—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: My prayer?
choice_data_list: It's all thanks to your wish, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying... that wasn't bad luck
just now...
but good luck?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Th-that would mean... the gods were
listening?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It must be because you prayed with me...
It feels
like a weight has been lifted from
me!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It must be because you prayed with me...
It feels
like a weight has been lifted from
me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her prayers answered, Rice Shower
beams with
joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Part of the old roof falls off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... This is all my fault!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The moment I try to run after her, I
stumble over
a gutter in the stone path.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother! Are you okay? I'm sorry...
This is all
my fault.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister! Are you okay? I'm sorry...
This
is all my
fault.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I try to
reassure her,
she won't stop beating
herself up about what
happened.
